(PTP1B)), and transcription factors (e.g., nuclear factor erythroid-derived 2-like 2 (NRF2), nuclear factor kappa B (NFkB))
Changing plasma membrane properties, such as membrane stability, curvature, ﬂuidity, permeability, composition, membrane microdomains (lipid rafts/
